coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, up +Z; neutral quadrupedal stance.

concept.reason: Primary whole-skeleton figure and museum specimen descriptions sufficient; no extra concept image.

scope: Original whole organism: two staggered rows of high dorsal plates and four tail spikes.
specimen_basis: Sophie, NHMUK PV R36730. Mounted skeleton and unmounted elements inspected in Maidment et al.2015 Figure1. Not fully skeletally mature; model is this size class, not a maximum-sized adult.

scale.basis: NHM specimen interview: just over5.5m; use approximate5.5m reconstruction, not genus9m maximum.

diagnostic_targets: Two longitudinal staggered rows, 19 total broad thin plates, not19 symmetric pairs. Plates gradually enlarge toward back/hips then diminish along tail.
Exactly four tail spikes, in two bilateral pairs near distal tail, pointing outward/backward rather than a vertical stegosaur fin.
Very small low beaked head on extended neck, bulky torso, high hips, hindlimbs longer than forelimbs.
Four weight-bearing feet, tapering raised tail; no shoulder spikes, ankylosaur club, bipedal stance or giant predatory head.
uncertainties: Soft tissue, colour, keratin thickness and exact mounted posture are reconstructions.
Left arm and tail base incompleteness require symmetry/comparative reconstruction; sex is unknown despite nickname Sophie.
Plate exact lateral tilt and tail spike angle are artistic approximations, not new osteological measurements.
acceptance_checks: Front/top shows genuine offset alternating double rows; not one central row or paired mirrored plates.
Side silhouette has size-graded thin plates, small head, low front and higher hindquarter, long tapering tail.
Four distinct integrated tail spikes visible without extra shoulder spikes; maintain clean negative spaces.
Default four views only; perspective may reuse preview. Original geometry/materials, no downloaded scan/mesh/texture.

workflow.tests_scope: Maker source/export/format/Node loader/dual rebuild only; not independent visual/factual acceptance, GPU, scene, user acceptance, or deployment.

handoff_contract: Same directory prep/maker/QA. Maker reports fixed hash COMPLETE then stops; no upload or cleanup. Root asynchronous private backup, integration local-first and cleanup only later when authorized. Hold candidate for later batch, no PR.
